questions.question: According to the reading, what is the essential concept behind the Day of the Dead?
options: People stay at home and avoid cemeteries for two days.
People pray that the dead will never come back.
People mourn the dead quietly in church.
People celebrate death with joy and humor rather than mourn it with sorrow.
questions.answer: People celebrate death with joy and humor rather than mourn it with sorrow.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.82 第1段：this is the essential concept behind the Mexican festival called the Day of the Dead, when people celebrate death with joy and humor rather than mourn it with sorrow.

They hold a funeral in the church.

(B) Mexico City has held an official parade since the 14th century.
(C) The Spanish arrived in 1519 and immediately banned the festival forever.
(D) The Aztecs used skulls to honor the deceased because they believed death was an ever-present part of life.
(E) After the Spanish conquest, the celebrations were moved to All Saints' Day (Nov. 1) and All Souls' Day (Nov. 2).
